Kozova Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Ternopilska oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. Kozova's Jewish community, present from the early 17th century, was served by named rabbis including Jacob Reinman (1778–1814) and Yosef Rotenberg, son-in-law of Zvi-Hirsch Aichenstein of Zhidachov; the tzaddik Moshe Langner (1878–1945) also lived in the town in the early 20th century. A 1906 fire left 300 Jewish families homeless. In October 1941, a pogrom claimed 300 lives, and the ghetto's liquidation on June 12, 1943, followed the deportation of about 1,000 Jews to the Bełżec extermination camp the previous September. A few Jewish families still resided in Kozova as recently as 2003.
